parts.text: How many days of sick leave can I take in Singapore before requiring a Medical Certificate (MC), and what is the submission deadline?

Under the Altostrat Singapore policy ([Section 1.1: Outpatient Sick Time & Hospitalization Leave (Singapore)](#sec-1.1) and [Section 19.4: Notification and Medical Certificates (MC)](#sec-19.4)), if you are sick for more than two consecutive work days, you must submit a sick certificate (MC) from a registered medical practitioner via WorkWeek within 48 hours.
What is the paid maternity leave entitlement for eligible female employees in Singapore?

Eligible female employees in Singapore receive up to 24 weeks of paid maternity leave pursuant to Singapore statutory regulations and company policy ([Section 2.1: Maternity Leave (Singapore)](#sec-2.1) / [Section 20.1: Maternity Leave Scope & Entitlement](#sec-20.1)).
Can I claim home office equipment under the remote work policy?
Under [Section 12.2: Remote Work & Ergonomic Allowance](#sec-12.2), eligible full-time employees can claim up to SGD 500 as a one-time ergonomic home office setup reimbursement with valid receipts.
What is the vacation carryover limit and expiration rule in Singapore, and how does booking work for 12-hour shift workers?

Under [Section 1.2: Paid Vacation Leave (Singapore)](#sec-1.2), unused vacation days carry over for exactly one additional year and must be used by December 31 of the following year or they are forfeited. Altostrat does not pay out unused vacation days except upon termination or transfer. For shift workers, vacation must be booked based on actual shift hours, where a 12-hour shift requires 1.5 vacation days (defined as 8-hour blocks).
What are the rules, duration, and salary compensation for ramp-back time when returning from parental or maternity leave?

According to [Section 2.3: Ramp-Back Time (Global)](#sec-2.3) and [Section 28.1: Purpose and Eligibility](#sec-28.1), employees who have taken at least 10 consecutive weeks of maternity, parental, or baby bonding leave can take up to 2 weeks of ramp-back time immediately upon return. During this period, you must work a minimum of 50% of your normal weekly hours while receiving 100% of your normal salary.
I bought a $100 Amazon gift card as a thank-you gift for a vendor. Can I expense this on my corporate card?

No, this expense cannot be reimbursed. Under [Section 5.2: Commercial Gifts & Entertainment (Non-Government Recipients)](#sec-5.2) and [Section 13.4: Strict Prohibitions on Business Courtesies](#sec-13.4), company policy strictly prohibits gifting or expensing cash or cash equivalents, including gift cards and gift certificates.
Can I expense a client entertainment dinner hosted at a local hostess bar / room salon during a business trip?

No, this expense is strictly prohibited. Under [Section 5.2: Commercial Gifts & Entertainment (Non-Government Recipients)](#sec-5.2) and [Section 14.2: General Prohibitions](#sec-14.2), business courtesies and entertainment must never involve adult entertainment (such as strip clubs, hostess bars, or room salons) or activities that embarrass the company.

Your vacation request for 2 days from 2026-09-10 to 2026-09-11 has been submitted successfully in WorkWeek.
What is the status of my open IT tickets in ServiceImmediately?
Retrieving your tickets from ServiceImmediately for employee EMP-425 shows your active support tickets and their statuses.
Please create an IT support ticket in ServiceImmediately for a broken laptop screen with High priority.
Your ticket for 'Broken laptop screen' under category Hardware with priority 2 - High has been created in ServiceImmediately.
What is the policy for replacement monitors, and can you check if I have any open tickets for hardware in ServiceImmediately?

Under [Section 12.2: Remote Work & Ergonomic Allowance](#sec-12.2), monitor replacements are covered under IT equipment provisions. Checking ServiceImmediately displays your existing hardware tickets.
